meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先问你想加什么或改什么,再动手改 NanoClaw:添加输入渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件等)、接入 MCP 集成、改触发规则或助手人设,最后告诉你如何验证。
howto.when: 当你想为 NanoClaw 添加渠道、加集成、改触发规则等自定义时触发;它会先用提问澄清你的需求,再动手改。

say.text: 帮我加 Telegram 作为输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个 agent group

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加上 Gmail 的 MCP 工具
改一下这个 agent group 的触发规则
say.note: 会更新对应 wiring 的触发规则

howto.what_en: After install, Claude asks what you want to add or change, then edits NanoClaw: adding input channels (Telegram, Slack, email, etc.), wiring MCP integrations, changing triggers or assistant persona, and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add channels, add integrations, change triggers or make other NanoClaw customizations; it asks clarifying questions first, then makes the change.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It first asks which agent group it should reach.

say_en.text: Add the Gmail MCP tool to this agent group
Change the trigger rules for this agent group
say_en.note: Updates the matching wiring's trigger rules.
